patch_description: Key parameters in the current program: 4 structured inits each annealed 9000 iters + 3000 polish, then 2 plain reheat cycles (4000+2000). Runtime 9.91s without score gain. Following the budget-rebalance recommendation: cut per-seed anneal to 1500 iterations, keep a pool of all candidates (instead of discarding non-best), and add 3 round-robin crossover reheat passes where each pool member is perturbed toward another member via interpolation 0.7*p_i + 0.3*p_j — a structural basin-mixing escape that plain restarts lack. Also skip the axis-wise fallback (it inflated runtime without gains), keep short targeted polish after each reheat, and use incremental area updates only where trivial. Total budget is kept around 5-6s since prior data shows more time past that doesn't pay.
